title: Statutory Article Retrieval from Arabic Judicial Narratives: Family Law and Law of Evidence in Saudi Arabia
abstract: arXiv:2610.38336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable legal information retrieval must ground legal reasoning in authoritative statutory sources. In Arabic judicial settings, long factual narratives must be mapped to concise articles that express abstract legal rules, creating a narrative-to-legal-rule abstraction gap. Using a benchmark of 200 synthetic Saudi Arabic judicial cases and 381 articles from the Family Law and the Law of Evidence, we compare word-level and char-4 BM25, zero-shot dense encoders, per-law retrieval, dense-sparse reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and a proposed Decompose-and-Refine (DaR) pipeline. In DaR, a large language model splits each narrative into disputed legal issues and generates, for each issue, three retrieval channels: a statute-style paraphrase, legal keywords, and a candidate taxonomy chapter. On the whole corpus, the instructed Qwen3-Embedding-8B dense encoder reaches an MRR@10 of 0.849, the best result of any non-decomposed system. Under per-l

translated_title: 从阿拉伯语司法叙述中检索法条：沙特阿拉伯家庭法与证据法
translated_abstract: 可靠的法律信息检索必须将法律推理建立在权威的法律条文来源之上。在阿拉伯语司法环境中，冗长的事实性叙述需要映射到表达抽象法律规则的简洁条文上，由此产生了从叙述到法律规则之间的抽象化鸿沟。我们使用包含200个合成沙特阿拉伯司法案例的基准数据集以及来自《家庭法》和《证据法》的381条条文，对比了词级和字符4元BM25、零样本稠密编码器、按法检索、稠密-稀疏倒数排序融合（RRF）以及我们提出的“分解-精炼”管道。在DaR方法中，大语言模型将每个司法叙述拆分为多个争议法律问题，并为每个问题生成三个检索通道：法条风格的改写表述、法律关键词以及候选法条分类章节。在整个语料库上，经指令优化的Qwen3-Embedding-8B稠密编码器达到了0.849的MRR@10，是所有非分解系统中最好的结果。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个“分解-精炼”管道，利用大语言模型将阿拉伯语司法叙述拆分为争议法律问题并生成多通道检索表述，以弥合事实叙述与抽象法条之间的鸿沟，从而提升沙特家庭法与证据法条文的检索效果。
